supersedes_scope.geometry_ambiguity: fills missing executable definition for frozen GEOMETRY fields without changing their domains

cause.event_axis: V215 candidate_event_id included signal_config_id while GA1 required exact event-mask equality for semantic dedupe; this makes non-empty masks configuration-specific and defeats dedupe by construction.
cause.geometry: Exact frozen public source describes contraction qualitatively as smaller fractal boxes toward EMA ribbon but provides no executable contraction formula.

source_findings: Fractal Box is the area between latest confirmed fractal high and low levels
source recommends waiting for contraction resulting in smaller boxes
source contains no mathematical contraction formula

corrected_event_identity.availability_source_record_index: earliest canonical DEV source-tick record index at which the final signal candidate is observable; tick/retest-intrabar uses the triggering quote record; completed-bar candidate uses the first source quote that makes that completed bar causally known
corrected_event_identity.candidate_instance_id: separate audit identity may include signal_config_id, level identity and transform signature but MUST NOT be used as mask coordinate
corrected_event_identity.dedupe_scope: exact canonical mask equality within identical asset+side+timeframe only

geometry_semantics.fractal_box: latest causally confirmed same-timeframe fractal-high level and fractal-low level
geometry_semantics.box_state_update: a distinct state is appended whenever either confirmed high-level identity or confirmed low-level identity changes and both levels exist
geometry_semantics.contraction_n: for n in {2,3,4}, the last n distinct box-state widths in chronological order must be strictly decreasing at every transition; repeated bars with unchanged box state do not count
geometry_semantics.max_box_atr: box_width / ATR14 <= threshold using causal ATR14 available at final candidate snapshot
geometry_semantics.max_midpoint_to_fast_ema_atr: abs(box_midpoint-fastEMA)/ATR14 <= threshold at final candidate snapshot
geometry_semantics.fastEMA_dependency: active TREND fast EMA when TREND active, otherwise EMA35, as frozen V210
geometry_semantics.missing_or_nonpositive_atr: active ATR-normalized geometry clause fails closed

bar_anchor_semantics.intraday: source-server civil bars anchored at source-server 00:00; M2/M3/M4/M5/M6/M10/M12/M15/M20/M30/H1/H2/H3/H4 use exact integer multiples from that midnight
bar_anchor_semantics.raw_timestamp_rule: preserve archived server-clock civil labels; do not silently relabel raw timestamps as UTC for bar construction

retest_window_completion.window_bars: N counts signal-timeframe bars whose interval contains or follows the breakout availability; same-bar intrabar touch/reclaim is eligible for TOUCH_RECLAIM; pending retest expires when the Nth eligible bar becomes completed without reclaim
retest_window_completion.close_reclaim: candidate availability is first source quote after the reclaim bar completes
retest_window_completion.touch_reclaim: candidate availability is the reclaiming source quote

required_validation: dual unit canaries plus exact dedupe demonstration before real GA1
